### Observed differences

- A03 was not observed in the earlier window (0 of 200 traces) but appears in about 52 in 100 traces in the later window (103 of 200), roughly 0.5 times per trace and never repeated within a trace. [OCC001]
- In the earlier window, A11 followed the A08/A12 pair closely: A08's outgoing transitions split about 51/49 between A11 and A12, A12's about 51/49 between A08 and A11, and the gap from A08/A12 to A11 was always 1 or 2 steps. In the later window, about 38 in 100 of A08's outgoing transitions and 33 in 100 of A12's go to A03 instead, the A08/A12-to-A11 gap now reaches 3 steps in about a third of observations, and the direct A08–A12 succession is sometimes 2 steps apart (about 32–40 in 100) where it was previously always 1. [DIR003, DIR004, LAG002, LAG005, LAG003, LAG004]
- A03 itself, unobserved earlier, now leads to A12 (about 36% of its outgoing transitions), A11 (about 35%) and A08 (about 29%), and appears a bit over a third of the way into the trace (median relative position about 0.38). [DIR001, POS001]
- A03 and A11 were never seen in the same trace earlier (A11 appeared without A03 in about 51 in 100 traces); in the later window they co-occur in about 52 in 100 traces, with A03 before A11 in every co-occurrence. [REL003]
- A03's relations with A05, A08 and A12 changed the same way: from no co-occurrence (the partner alone in about 51 in 100 traces) to co-occurrence in about 52 in 100 traces, in mixed order for A08 (A03 first in about 23 in 100, A08 first in about 29) and A12 (A03 first in about 26, A12 first in about 26), and with A05 mostly before A03 (about 28 in 100) or interleaved with it (about 24 in 100). [REL001, REL002, REL004]
- The A05-to-A11 distance, earlier 3 steps in about 43 in 100 observations and 5 steps in about 19, is now always 4 steps. [LAG001]
- A05's routing shifted: its transitions to A07 fell from about 58% to 45% of its outgoing transitions while a new transition to A03 appeared (about 16%), and A05 now occurs slightly earlier (median relative position about 0.18 to 0.0); A11's own position is essentially unchanged (mean about 0.55 in both windows). [DIR002, POS002, POS003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that A03 now runs as an additional step woven into the A05–A08–A12 sequence and placed before A11. In the earlier window, A11 was reached from A08 and A12 within 1–2 steps and A03 never appeared; in the later window, A05, A08 and A12 frequently hand over to A03, A03 always precedes A11 when both occur, and the distances from A05/A08/A12 to A11 lengthened accordingly (a third step appeared after A08/A12, and A05's distance settled at a fixed 4). This reading is direct and consistent across participation, successor, relation, distance and position items, and the 17 qualifying control-flow items are about 100 times the 0.17 expected for an unchanged process, so sampling variation cannot explain the pattern as a whole; each item's difference also exceeds about 995 of 1000 random re-splits. The main limitation is that zero participation in the earlier window strictly shows only that A03 was not observed there, so a newly added step cannot be distinguished from one previously too rare to appear in 200 traces; moreover, because A03's order relative to A08 and A12 is mixed, the exact insertion point within that group is not pinned down, and several items describe the same traces and are not independent confirmations. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, REL003, REL001, REL002, REL004, LAG001, LAG002, LAG005, POS001]

Other differences: A05 occurs slightly earlier in the trace (median relative position about 0.18 to 0.0) and its share of transitions to A07 decreased (from about 58% to 45% of A05's outgoing transitions), consistent with rerouting through A03 but not required by the main hypothesis; A11's position within the trace stayed essentially the same. [POS002, DIR002, POS003]
